packageRules.description: Group HelmRelease/HelmRepository updates by chart name so a chart's release and its repo move together.
Group plain Kubernetes image updates by the manifest's workload name.

vllm/vllm-openai ships arch/CUDA-variant suffixes (-aarch64, -aarch64-cu130) that are not optional extras to drop during a version bump. Regex versioning keeps the suffix fixed as a 'compatibility' capture group per https://docs.renovatebot.com/modules/versioning/regex/ while still comparing major.minor.patch numerically, so Renovate never proposes swapping -aarch64 for a bare tag or a different CUDA variant.
